findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "01 / Selected work" above "Projects"; "Individual project · Full-stack development" above "SkyFire"; "Team project · Submission review and grading" above "mAIstra"; "03" above "Bulk Buying Companion"; "04" above "Pulso"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "01 / Selected work", "SkyFire / Preview", "In the walkthrough", "01"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 9 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "01 / Selected work", "In the walkthrough", "In the walkthrough", "In the walkthrough").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.phone-frame → rgb(48, 56, 52) 0px 0px 0px 2px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 14px 28px 0px | div.phone-frame → rgb(48, 56, 52) 0px 0px 0px 2px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 14px 28px 0px | div.phone-frame → rgb(48, 56, 52) 0px 0px 0px 2px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0px 14px 28px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header#top.portfolio-header 1410px | section.intro-section.shell 1410px | div.project-preview-bar 659px | figcaption.selected-project-flow 696px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Manrope, ui-monospace, Bodoni Moda).

findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Gambarino and General Sans, but the page renders Manrope, ui-monospace.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: The margins differ: 58px on the left, 118px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("JAYRALD TAJANLANGIT") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 10 different lines (58px, 575px, 832px, 91px, 850px, 989px, 109px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 5 of 7 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.
